newsitem.title: ECUADOR: Ecuador's coffee exports fell 27.3 pct in Jan-June.
newsitem.headline: Ecuador's coffee exports fell 27.3 pct in Jan-June.

text.p: Ecuador's coffee exports fell 27.3 percent in the first six months of 1997 to 359,136 60-kg bags due to the retention plan of the Association of Coffee Producing Countries (ACPC), an exporters group said Thursday.
The National Coffee Exporters Association said Ecuador shipped 494,067 bags in the first six months of 1996.
Meanwhile, coffee revenues fell 27.6 percent in the January-June period to $37.4 million from $51.7 million in the comparable period of 1996.
In all of 1996, Ecuador's coffee exports fell to 1.56 million 60-kg bags from 1.9 million bags exported in 1995.
Ecuador plans to export 1.2 million bags between July 1997 and June 1998.
Coffee is Ecuador's fifth export earner, after oil, banana, shrimp and cacao.
